annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, Japan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Warehouse operators must stagger delivery times and use arrival-time display systems to cut driver waiting time.
Truck-related operators must improve loading/unloading efficiency through space, manuals, forklifts, pallets and inspection machines.
Operators must appoint a responsible person, train staff, and monitor waiting times and measures.
Operators should standardise logistics data to improve interoperability.
Operators should introduce automated guided vehicles to automate facility work.
named_instruments_referenced: 物資の流通の効率化に関する法律
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MLIT ministerial ordinance setting criteria for warehouse and truck-related operators to shorten driver waiting and loading times under the Act on Efficiency of Physical Distribution. It includes a passing provision encouraging automated guided vehicles for facility work.
annotation.title_clean: 貨物自動車関連事業者の貨物自動車運送役務の持続可能な提供の確保に資する運転者の運送及び荷役等の効率化に関する判断の基準となるべき事項を定める省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance Establishing Criteria for Truck-Related Operators on Improving Efficiency of Drivers' Transport and Loading/Unloading to Ensure Sustainable Provision of Truck Transport Services
